name: Pika
summary: Creative AI tools for generating and editing short videos.
description: Pika provides AI tools to generate and transform short videos from text and images, including playful effects for social media. It positions itself on creative, effect-driven video rather than long cinematic shots. A free plan is available to try the tools, and paid plans unlock more credits, higher quality and commercial features.
